At the start of the season, resources and gear are very limited, and the first few crafted pieces are crucial for progressing efficiently. Here is the best early crafting order for Marksmanship Hunter using  Spark of Radiance, targetting the quickest power gains:

All Crafts are 4 iLvls lower than the maximum Mythic Track Item Level of 289, but they have the benefit of offering Embellishments, of which we can have 2. The goal is to find the strongest Embellishments, on the items that will lose the least amount of stats by being crafted, and then fill in other pieces around those.
Craft  World Tender's Barkclasp Explanation 
Craft  World Tender's RootslippersExplanation 
Replace Low Item Level Pieces, preferring Weapon > Neck/Rings > Cloak/Wrists. Other item slots are generally not crafted, as they are taken up by Tier or other uniquely strong pieces.
